title: Migrating from Claude Code / Codex
small: Keep your @file, annotation and TUI habits — and bring your session history
blurb: Recreate the @file references, annotations and fullscreen TUI you're used to, and import your full session history into dsh.
lede: For users coming from Claude Code or Codex, this page covers two things: recreating your existing workflow in dsh (@file, annotations, fullscreen TUI), and importing your session history in full.
habit: Fullscreen terminal UI, streaming output, Esc to roll back
@file references that pull workspace files into the prompt
Importing Claude Code sessions and continuing them
rx_a: A Claude Code-style fullscreen TUI. Streaming thought expansion, rollback controls, context/TPS indicators. Your muscle memory mostly carries over.
Codex-style @file references. Type @ to search workspace files and attach them to your prompt. Pairs with dsh-annotation (select-and-annotate) — worth installing together.
Select text, annotate, send. The core input pattern for Codex users, from the dsh-external org. The audit found no tests or CI in the current version.
A Codex-style theme switcher. Purely visual, so low risk — but updates are infrequent, and major dsh releases may need an adaptation window. Check maintenance status before installing.
rx_b: Imports session history from Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, Cursor and 8 other tools — tool calls and reasoning blocks included — as fully resumable dsh sessions, not read-only archives. Source files are never modified. The first plugin on this site to pass all four checks.

Search sessions across tools. Works without migrating anything. Caution: the audit found the current version does not declare dsh.bundle — per the official docs it won't activate after install. Watch for a fix, or follow the README's own instructions.
